lines.text: Somewhere, a freshly mopped floor is about to meet a crowd of wet shoes. Great timing.
Someone will stand with their mouth open and call it connecting with nature.
Someone will complain about the cold with their jacket hanging open. The zipper is innocent.
Somewhere, a sweater will come off and reveal enough lint to knit another.
Someone will put a dripping umbrella straight back in their bag. A bold storage decision.
Even your umbrella knows when to shut up. You could learn something.
